body:
### Summary

- I get email from dependabot that setuptools < 83 has some CVE that doesn't affect me in any way, but still
- I run `uv sync --upgrade` to update all the pinned packages in my uv.lock
- I look at git diff and I see that uv sync did not touch setuptools, which remains pinned to version 81.0.0
- (repeat with `uv sync --upgrade --resolution highest`, same result)

If you want to see my lockfile/pyproject.toml, it's at https://github.com/mgedmin/ShoppingList/:
- setuptools is not a direct dependency, but uv tree shows that I depend on Pyramid, which depends on setuptools.
- setuptools is also a build requirment

### Platform

Ubuntu 26.04

### Version

uv 0.12.5 (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)

### Python version

Python 3.14.4
title: uv sync --upgrade does not upgrade a transitive dependency (setuptools)
